identity.description: An attacker uses Windows Update mechanisms to download and execute malicious payloads over HTTP, bypassing typical network controls. Cortex should detect this rare MS-Update traffic pattern and associated process behavior.

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound HTTP connection to C2 server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare MS-Update traffic over HTTP
biocs.description: Detection of unusual HTTP traffic originating from Windows Update components
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 80
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'wuauclt.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Usage with Update Mechanism
abiocs.description: PowerShell executing download commands within a Windows Update context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'wuauclt.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'update.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare MS-Update Traffic
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 80
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'wuauclt.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() by agent_hostname
